points.K9: 离心腔干燥，驱动轴干净

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台落地式离心机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large floor-standing centrifuge with its lid closed and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲离心机的危害和安全使用。

shots.scene: 转子、天平、密封盖、记录本四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a centrifuge rotor, a balance scale, a sealed lid with a lock, and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 选得对、装得稳、封得严、记得全。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两支液量明显不同的离心管，急着往台式离心机里放
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hurries to drop two centrifuge tubes with clearly different liquid levels into an open benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶时间，管子没配平就想开机。

shots.scene: 两支液面高低不同的离心管图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two tubes with very different liquid levels side by side, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这一转，离心机可能剧烈晃动。

shots.scene: 小研按住阿杰的手，指向离心机盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the young male student's hand and points at the centrifuge lid.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先配平，再检查转子。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 离心机转得飞快，一点疏忽都会放大。

shots.section_title: 本课是补充，不能代替培训
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白教材，旁边是空白培训证书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank booklet next to a blank training certificate on an easel.
shots.narration: 这一课是补充，不能代替正式培训。
overlay: 本课是补充，不能代替培训

shots.section_title: 本课是补充，不能代替培训
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 本单位、本实验室的培训一样都不能少。

shots.scene: 离心机腔内转子碎裂的示意图标，碎片四散
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway icon of a centrifuge chamber with a shattered rotor and fragments flying outward, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 转子一旦失效，后果非常严重。

shots.scene: 被撞歪的离心机外壳图标和金额图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dented centrifuge cabinet pushed out of place next to a coin stack icon with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 伤人虽少见，设备和经费损失却很大。

shots.scene: 欣欣认真地轻拍离心机机盖
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the closed lid of a centrifuge with a serious face.
shots.narration: 离心机很重要，必须认真对待。

shots.section_title: 多数事故源于操作失误
shots.scene: 十个小人图标中九个被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A row of ten small person pictograms, nine of them highlighted in orange next to a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 约九成离心事故，源于操作失误。
overlay: 多数事故源于操作失误

shots.section_title: 多数事故源于操作失误
shots.scene: 打翻的样品管、损坏的仪器、受伤的小人三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a spilled sample tube, a broken instrument with a crack, and a person pictogram with a bandage. No people.
shots.narration: 粗心会丢样品、坏设备，还会伤人。

shots.section_title: 多数事故源于操作失误
shots.scene: 整个实验室房间图标上方出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab room icon with a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 甚至危及整个实验室。

shots.section_title: 每次离心前的五个选择
shots.scene: 小研站在离心机前，身旁浮现五张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in front of a centrifuge, five blank cards floating beside her.
shots.narration: 每次离心，都要先做几个选择。
overlay: 每次离心前的五个选择

shots.section_title: 每次离心前的五个选择
shots.scene: 五张卡片上依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five blank cards each getting a green check mark one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 这些选择，关系效果，更关系安全。

shots.section_title: 转子有转速和载荷上限
shots.scene: 离心机和转子用锁扣图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge icon and a rotor icon linked by a matching puzzle connector. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机只能配用指定的转子。
overlay: 转子有转速和载荷上限

shots.section_title: 转子有转速和载荷上限
shots.scene: 转子旁的仪表盘，指针在红区之前
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon next to a speed gauge with a red zone at the top and a weight icon with a limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 每个转子都有最高转速和载荷上限。

shots.section_title: 转子有转速和载荷上限
shots.scene: 指针冲进红区，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: The speed gauge needle pushes into the red zone, and the icon is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超出上限，就是在招惹事故。

shots.scene: 小研翻阅一本空白的转子说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a thick blank instrument manual with simple rotor diagrams.
shots.narration: 拿不准转子或管子规格，先查说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周请教，老周指着离心机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man a question; the older man points at the centrifuge and explains.
shots.narration: 问问有经验的老师和同事。

shots.scene: 电话图标和工具图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a wrench and gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 或者联系厂家的技术支持。

shots.scene: 货架上各种大小的离心瓶和离心管
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with centrifuge bottles and tubes of many different sizes, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 离心管看似普通，选错尺寸却很危险。

shots.scene: 管子刚好嵌入转子孔，打绿勾；松垮的管子打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a tube fitting snugly into a rotor hole with a green check, and a loose undersized tube in a hole crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管子必须和转子孔完全匹配。

shots.scene: 强大的向外箭头压向一支变形的管子
shots.prompt_en: Large outward force arrows press on a tube that bends and cracks inside a rotor hole. No people.
shots.narration: 几十万倍重力下，不匹配就会出事。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸
shots.scene: 欣欣举起生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 离心前还要想好：需要什么防护级别。
overlay: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸
shots.scene: 带密封盖的离心管和带密封盖的转子
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge tube with a sealed screw cap and a rotor with a sealed lid and a lock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性材料，必须用密封管和密封转子。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸
shots.scene: 飘出的小雾点被密封盖挡住
shots.prompt_en: Tiny mist droplets rise from a tube and are blocked by a sealed lid on top. No people.
shots.narration: 密封能把离心产生的气溶胶关在里面。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸
shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜手套，在生物安全柜内拧紧转子密封盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, tightens a sealed rotor lid inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 装管、拧盖，都在生物安全柜里完成。

shots.section_title: 感染性材料：密封离心、柜内装卸
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里打开密封转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the sealed rotor lid inside the biological safety cabinet, working behind the front sash.
shots.narration: 离心结束，也回到安全柜里再打开。

shots.section_title: 离心腔干燥，驱动轴干净
shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦干离心腔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, wipes the inside of a centrifuge bowl dry with paper towels.
shots.narration: 普通样品，每一步准备也不能马虎。
overlay: 离心腔干燥，驱动轴干净

shots.section_title: 离心腔干燥，驱动轴干净
shots.scene: 离心腔和驱动轴特写，水珠和污渍图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a clean dry centrifuge bowl and drive spindle; small icons of water drops and dirt beside it are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 放转子前，腔体要干、驱动轴要净。

shots.scene: 移液器向离心管加液，液面停在管子中部
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pipettes liquid into centrifuge tubes in a rack, stopping well below the top. No people.
shots.narration: 离心管和离心瓶，不要装得过满。

shots.scene: 角转子剖面示意，液体斜贴管外侧壁
shots.prompt_en: A simple cross-section diagram of a fixed angle rotor; liquid inside two tilted tubes slants up the outer wall. No people.
shots.narration: 角转子里，液体会被甩向管外侧上方。

shots.scene: 装满的管子在倾斜时溢出，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an overfilled tilted tube with liquid leaking from the cap, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装太满，就容易从管口漏出来。

shots.scene: 小研双手把转子放上驱动轴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers a rotor with both hands straight down onto the drive spindle inside the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 转子要稳稳落座在驱动轴上。

shots.scene: 转子歪斜卡在轴上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rotor sitting tilted on the spindle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 歪着放、没放到底，都不行。

shots.scene: 小研在天平上称两支离心管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs a centrifuge tube on a balance next to its paired tube.
shots.narration: 配平至关重要。

shots.scene: 一粒小砝码在平地上，另一粒变成巨大的砝码
shots.prompt_en: A tiny weight icon on the ground, then the same weight shown as a giant heavy block under a spinning rotor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 半克之差，平时不算什么。

shots.scene: 巨大的砝码压向转子一侧，转子倾斜
shots.prompt_en: The giant heavy block presses on one side of the spinning rotor icon, making it tilt. No people.
shots.narration: 在五十万倍重力下，相当于250千克。

shots.scene: 小研把配平好的管子对称放入转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places two balanced tubes into opposite holes of the rotor.
shots.narration: 配好平，再对称放进转子。

shots.scene: 转子上方的重量图标超过限线
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon with a weight icon rising above a limit line. No people.
shots.narration: 装载超过转子最大质量，

shots.scene: 转速表指针向下调低
shots.prompt_en: A speed dial icon with the needle turned down to a lower mark, with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 必须按要求降低转速，否则不能运行。

shots.scene: 小研提起水平转子，吊篮挂在挂臂上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts a swinging bucket rotor; each bucket hangs on its pins.
shots.narration: 用水平转子，每个吊篮都要挂好。

shots.scene: 吊篮来回摆动，一个卡住的吊篮被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Buckets swing freely on their pins; a separate icon of a stuck bucket is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吊篮要能自由摆动，不能卡住。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用工具取下O形密封圈
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands lift a rubber O-ring from a container lid with a small plastic tool.
shots.narration: 检查容器和转子上的O形密封圈。

shots.scene: 密封圈上的裂纹、缺口、腐蚀斑三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an O-ring with three small icons: a crack, a nick and a stain. No people.
shots.narration: 有裂纹、缺口或被腐蚀，就要更换。

shots.scene: 手指给密封圈涂一薄层润滑脂
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger applies a thin layer of grease to an O-ring seal.
shots.narration: 密封处至少每周涂一次真空脂。

shots.section_title: 固定转子、盖好拧紧、核对转速
shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers with a serious look.
shots.narration: 最常见的三个失误，要特别留心。
overlay: 固定转子、盖好拧紧、核对转速

shots.section_title: 固定转子、盖好拧紧、核对转速
shots.scene: 转子与驱动轴没锁住、没盖盖、盖子松动三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: a rotor not locked to the spindle, a rotor without its lid, and a loose lid. No people.
shots.narration: 转子没固定、没盖盖、盖了没拧紧。

shots.section_title: 固定转子、盖好拧紧、核对转速
shots.scene: 小研拧紧转子盖，再关上离心机门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tightens the rotor lid, then closes the centrifuge door.
shots.narration: 固定转子，盖好盖并拧紧。

shots.section_title: 固定转子、盖好拧紧、核对转速
shots.scene: 小研对照空白的转速表格核对设定
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student runs her finger along a blank rotor speed table, then checks the blank control panel.
shots.narration: 开机前再核对：转速不超额定上限。

shots.scene: 小研站在离心机旁看着控制面板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the running centrifuge and watches the control panel with a blank display.
shots.narration: 启动后先别走开。

shots.scene: 转速指针稳稳停在设定线上
shots.prompt_en: A speed gauge needle rises and settles steadily on a target line. No people.
shots.narration: 守到平稳达到设定转速，再离开。

shots.scene: 转子仍在旋转时伸手开盖的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand opening a centrifuge lid while the rotor is still spinning, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行结束，转子没停稳不能开盖。

shots.scene: 转速表归零，小研打开离心机门
shots.prompt_en: The speed gauge drops to zero, and the female graduate student opens the centrifuge door.
shots.narration: 完全停止后，再打开门。

shots.scene: 小研探头检查离心腔壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks into the open centrifuge bowl and checks its wall carefully.
shots.narration: 开门先查有没有溢漏。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾清洁离心腔和转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles and gloves, cleans the bowl and the rotor with paper towels.
shots.narration: 有溢漏，离心机和转子都要彻底清洁。

shots.scene: 离心机门关闭，旁边一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed centrifuge with an hourglass icon beside it and tiny mist droplets settling inside. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性样品，停机等10分钟再开门。

shots.scene: 开门时雾点外飘的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of mist droplets escaping from a centrifuge door opened too early, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 让气溶胶沉降，别把它放出来。

shots.scene: 小研发现异常，立即合上门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sees a leak inside and immediately closes the centrifuge door.
shots.narration: 发现泄漏或破损，立即关门。

shots.scene: 小研和老周在空白计划板前商量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man discuss next steps in front of a blank planning board.
shots.narration: 想清楚怎么清理，再动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个大转子模型旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a large model of a centrifuge rotor.
shots.narration: 最怕的事故，是转子失效。

shots.scene: 转子表面的白色腐蚀斑和细小裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up illustration of a rotor surface with white corrosion spots and a fine crack. No people.
shots.narration: 转子很结实，但怕腐蚀和金属疲劳。

shots.scene: 铝转子孔边受力最大的部位亮起红色
shots.prompt_en: A simple aluminum rotor diagram with the high-stress areas around the holes glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 铝转子常坏在受力最大处的表面腐蚀。

shots.scene: 时钟图标旁，转子上的裂纹慢慢变长
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon beside a rotor diagram where a small crack slowly grows longer. No people.
shots.narration: 用得越久，疲劳越重，终会失效。

shots.scene: 转子图标配扳手和退役标签
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon with a wrench icon and a blank retirement tag hanging from it. No people.
shots.narration: 维护得当、按时退役，就能避免失效。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白说明书的维护章节
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank instrument manual to a page with maintenance icons.
shots.narration: 具体做法，遵循厂家的说明。

shots.scene: 转子和离心腔都干干净净
shots.prompt_en: A clean dry rotor sits beside a clean dry centrifuge bowl, with a sparkle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 设备保持清洁干燥，非常关键。

shots.scene: 盐粒和溅洒图标旁出现计时器
shots.prompt_en: Icons of salt crystals and a spill next to a stopwatch showing urgency. No people.
shots.narration: 有溅洒，或用过盐类等腐蚀性溶液，立即清洗。

shots.scene: 强力洗涤剂和带金属丝的硬刷被打叉，软刷打勾
shots.prompt_en: A harsh detergent bottle and a stiff brush with sharp wire ends crossed out with a red X; a soft brush with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不用强力洗涤剂和带尖金属丝的刷子。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边用软刷轻轻刷洗铝转子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, gently cleans the holes of an aluminum rotor with a soft brush at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 铝转子更容易腐蚀，清洗要格外轻柔。

shots.scene: 转子在龙头下冲洗，再倒置晾干
shots.prompt_en: A rotor is rinsed under a tap, then set upside down on a clean towel to dry. No people.
shots.narration: 最后用去离子水冲洗干净。

shots.scene: 小研拿着转子仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a rotor up to the light and inspects its surface closely.
shots.narration: 养成每次检查转子的习惯。

shots.scene: 转子表面四种问题图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotor surface with four small icons: rough spots, pits, white powder and dark discoloration. No people.
shots.narration: 粗糙、点蚀、白色粉末、明显变色。

shots.scene: 转子挂上停用标签，小研向老李报告
shots.prompt_en: A rotor with a blank do-not-use tag; the female graduate student reports to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 出现这些就停用，请厂家代表检查。

shots.scene: 一排转子，最旧的挂上退役标签
shots.prompt_en: A row of rotors from new to old, the oldest one with a blank retirement tag. No people.
shots.narration: 每个转子，终有退役的一天。

shots.scene: 超速转子旁的转速表上限被调低
shots.prompt_en: An ultracentrifuge rotor icon next to a speed gauge whose maximum mark moves down. No people.
shots.narration: 超速转子老化后，最高转速要降级。

shots.scene: 小研在空白的转子使用日志上记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank rotor logbook next to an ultracentrifuge.
shots.narration: 所以必须认真记录转子使用日志。

shots.scene: 没有记录的转子旁出现定时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotor with an empty blank logbook beside it and a ticking timer icon with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 没有记录的超速转子，就是定时炸弹。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在离心机前，身旁三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a centrifuge beside three icons: a hand, a wrench and a logbook.
shots.narration: 离心没有看上去那么简单。

shots.scene: 说明书和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank instrument manual icon and a telephone icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 答案都在说明书里，或者一个电话就能问到。

shots.scene: 被毁的样品管和皱眉表情图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a ruined sample tube and a frowning face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让粗心毁了离心机和你的实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现转子、离心管和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a rotor, a centrifuge tube and a balance scale.
shots.narration: 选对转子和管子，不超速、不超载。

shots.scene: 密封转子和生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a sealed rotor with a lock and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性材料，密封离心、柜内装卸。

shots.scene: 配平、落座、拧盖三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a balance scale, a rotor seated on a spindle and a tightened lid. No people.
shots.narration: 配平、落座、拧紧，守到平稳。

shots.scene: 停稳的转子、密封门和计划板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stopped rotor, a closed centrifuge door and a blank planning board. No people.
shots.narration: 停稳再开，有破漏先关门，计划好再清理。

shots.scene: 扳手、放大镜和日志本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wrench, a magnifying glass and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁、检查、记日志，按时退役。

shots.scene: 欣欣在离心机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy centrifuge with its lid closed.
shots.narration: 用心离心，安全实验，下次见！
